title: 道碴清篩與再利用~Ballast cleaning and reuse
focus: 粒徑分離再利用物料帳與排水性能~Gradation separation reuse mass accounts and drainage performance
summary: 道碴清篩與再利用以「粒徑分離再利用物料帳與排水性能」為主線，將十個物理或系統問題拆成機制、計算、驗證與診斷。清篩將受污染道碴分成可再用粗料與廢細料，回收比例不能取代粒形、強度及排水驗證；含水率和顆粒損傷會影響質量帳的解讀。每個單元附帶可重算的假想數據與敏感度，學員需提交帶單位的工作表、可區分失效的證據及模型邊界。~This course develops gradation separation reuse mass accounts and drainage performance through ten physical or systems questions, each studied through mechanism, calculation, verification and diagnosis. Cleaning separates fouled ballast into reusable coarse material and discarded fines, but recovery fraction cannot replace checks on particle shape, strength and drainage; moisture and particle damage affect the mass account. Every unit contains reproducible assumed inputs and a sensitivity calculation. Learners submit a worksheet with units, discriminating evidence for failures, and explicit model boundaries.
history: 本課把道碴清篩與再利用放在可追溯的技術演進脈絡中，不把機構研究、規範出版與個別路線通車混為一談。清篩將受污染道碴分成可再用粗料與廢細料，回收比例不能取代粒形、強度及排水驗證；含水率和顆粒損傷會影響質量帳的解讀。下列年代欄是工程事件、相關研究或規範出版節點；除明確標明實際工程事件者外，並非本專題設備的製造或投入營運日期。工程改進的判準是能否以量測區分假說，不能只依新舊設備外觀判斷。~The course places Ballast cleaning and reuse in a traceable engineering context and distinguishes institutional research, standards publication and the opening of individual lines. Cleaning separates fouled ballast into reusable coarse material and discarded fines, but recovery fraction cannot replace checks on particle shape, strength and drainage; moisture and particle damage affect the mass account. The timeline identifies engineering events, relevant research and standards-publication milestones. Unless explicitly labelled as a project event, a date is not the manufacture or commissioning date of the equipment. Improvement is assessed by whether measurements distinguish hypotheses, rather than by the apparent age of machinery.
example: 以下為跨單元的原創假想工作表。先用第一單元定義邊界與單位，再以第二單元檢查另一個控制量，最後用第三單元提出前兩式未涵蓋的另一個檢查問題。原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：feed=100 t, coarse=72 t, fines=25 t；y=feed-coarse-fines=3 t。只把 feed 增加百分之十，y=13 t。模型邊界：各料流均為同時間窗乾質量；差額包含存量變化；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：reusable=72 t, feed=100 t；y=reusable/feed*100=72 percent。只把 reusable 增加百分之十，y=79.2 percent。模型邊界：可再用質量已通過另列的材料檢查；比例不是檢驗合格概率；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。把兩個算例的單一輸入敏感度放在同一張決策表，說明哪個變化最值得先量測；不可把不同物理量的裸數字直接比較，也不可把任一結果當成實際設備的設計、施工或營運許可。~This original worksheet connects the first three units using assumed inputs. Establish boundaries and units with the first unit, examine another controlling quantity with the second, and use the third to pose a separate check outside the first two equations. Original assumed example, not field operating values: feed=100 t, coarse=72 t, fines=25 t; y=feed-coarse-fines=3 t. Increasing only feed with a ten-percent increase gives y=13 t. Boundary: All streams use dry mass over the same time window; the residual includes inventory change; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Original assumed example, not field operating values: reusable=72 t, feed=100 t; y=reusable/feed*100=72 percent. Increasing only reusable with a ten-percent increase gives y=79.2 percent. Boundary: Reusable mass has passed separate property checks; the ratio is not a probability of acceptance; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.Put both single-input sensitivities in one decision table and explain which change most deserves measurement. Do not compare bare numbers with different physical dimensions, and do not treat any result as design approval, a construction procedure or operating permission.

units.anchor: 清篩質量守恆~Cleaning mass conservation
units.title: 清篩質量守恆~Cleaning mass conservation
units.mechanism: 輸入減已知輸出應對應存量變化與量測差。本模型把 feed 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 13 t。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。各料流均為同時間窗乾質量；差額包含存量變化。使用各料流同步乾質量作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；未記錄存料會把正常暫存當成損耗，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Input minus known outputs corresponds to inventory change and measurement discrepancy. In this model, feed is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 13 t. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. All streams use dry mass over the same time window; the residual includes inventory change. Use synchronized dry mass in each material stream as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Unrecorded inventory makes temporary storage appear as loss; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：feed=100 t, coarse=72 t, fines=25 t；y=feed-coarse-fines=3 t。只把 feed 增加百分之十，y=13 t。模型邊界：各料流均為同時間窗乾質量；差額包含存量變化；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: feed=100 t, coarse=72 t, fines=25 t; y=feed-coarse-fines=3 t. Increasing only feed with a ten-percent increase gives y=13 t. Boundary: All streams use dry mass over the same time window; the residual includes inventory change; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以各料流同步乾質量區分模型與觀察，先用同步料流秤重、含水率修正及設備內存料盤點建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「清篩質量守恆」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use synchronized dry mass in each material stream to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using synchronized stream weighing, moisture correction and machine inventory reconciliation, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Cleaning mass conservation. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.
units.failure: 未記錄存料會把正常暫存當成損耗。這個失效與「清篩質量守恆」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查各料流同步乾質量，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。~Unrecorded inventory makes temporary storage appear as loss. This failure and a measurement bias in Cleaning mass conservation can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check synchronized dry mass in each material stream rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.
units.misconception: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：未記錄存料會把正常暫存當成損耗~This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Unrecorded inventory makes temporary storage appear as loss.
units.practice: 重算「清篩質量守恆」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出各料流均為同時間窗乾質量；差額包含存量變化如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由未記錄存料會把正常暫存當成損耗造成偏離的合成觀察，以各料流同步乾質量說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。~Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Cleaning mass conservation, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: All streams use dry mass over the same time window; the residual includes inventory change. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Unrecorded inventory makes temporary storage appear as loss. Explain which evidence in synchronized dry mass in each material stream distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.

units.anchor: 可再用材料比例~Reusable material fraction
units.title: 可再用材料比例~Reusable material fraction
units.mechanism: 回收率是物料比例而非材料性能合格率。本模型把 reusable 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 79.2 percent。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。可再用質量已通過另列的材料檢查；比例不是檢驗合格概率。使用粗料質量與獨立性能試驗作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；高回收率也可能保留脆弱顆粒，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Recovery is a material fraction rather than a performance acceptance rate. In this model, reusable is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 79.2 percent. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Reusable mass has passed separate property checks; the ratio is not a probability of acceptance. Use coarse mass and independent property tests as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. A high recovery fraction may retain weak particles; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：reusable=72 t, feed=100 t；y=reusable/feed*100=72 percent。只把 reusable 增加百分之十，y=79.2 percent。模型邊界：可再用質量已通過另列的材料檢查；比例不是檢驗合格概率；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: reusable=72 t, feed=100 t; y=reusable/feed*100=72 percent. Increasing only reusable with a ten-percent increase gives y=79.2 percent. Boundary: Reusable mass has passed separate property checks; the ratio is not a probability of acceptance; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以粗料質量與獨立性能試驗區分模型與觀察，先用乾質量秤重、粒形與強度試驗的批次對照建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「可再用材料比例」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use coarse mass and independent property tests to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using dry-mass weighing and batch-matched particle-shape and strength tests, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. units.anchor: 補充新道碴需求~Fresh ballast requirement
units.title: 補充新道碴需求~Fresh ballast requirement
units.mechanism: 需求扣除合格回料才得到新料需求。本模型把 demand 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 32.5 t。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。需求不少於合格回料且兩者同為乾質量；超額回料另列存量。使用可用回料與設計斷面作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；把全部粗料視為合格會低估新料，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Fresh demand is required material minus qualified recovered material. In this model, demand is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 32.5 t. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Demand is at least qualified recovery and both are dry mass; surplus recovery is separate inventory. Use usable recovered material and required section as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Treating all coarse material as qualified understates fresh demand; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：demand=95 t, recovered=72 t；y=demand-recovered=23 t。只把 demand 增加百分之十，y=32.5 t。模型邊界：需求不少於合格回料且兩者同為乾質量；超額回料另列存量；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: demand=95 t, recovered=72 t; y=demand-recovered=23 t. Increasing only demand with a ten-percent increase gives y=32.5 t. Boundary: Demand is at least qualified recovery and both are dry mass; surplus recovery is separate inventory; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以可用回料與設計斷面區分模型與觀察，先用設計材料需求、合格回料批號與乾質量帳建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「補充新道碴需求」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use usable recovered material and required section to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using required material quantity, qualified recovered batch IDs and dry-mass account, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Fresh ballast requirement. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.
units.failure: 把全部粗料視為合格會低估新料。這個失效與「補充新道碴需求」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查可用回料與設計斷面，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。~Treating all coarse material as qualified understates fresh demand. This failure and a measurement bias in Fresh ballast requirement can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check usable recovered material and required section rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. units.practice: 重算「補充新道碴需求」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出需求不少於合格回料且兩者同為乾質量；超額回料另列存量如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由把全部粗料視為合格會低估新料造成偏離的合成觀察，以可用回料與設計斷面說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。~Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Fresh ballast requirement, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Demand is at least qualified recovery and both are dry mass; surplus recovery is separate inventory. units.anchor: 含水率乾重換算~Moisture dry-mass conversion
units.title: 含水率乾重換算~Moisture dry-mass conversion
units.mechanism: 含水率以乾質量為分母時，濕質量須除一加含水率。本模型把 wet 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 110 kg。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。含水率定義為水質量除乾料質量；水分分布具有代表性。使用濕重及乾燥後質量作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；混用濕基與乾基含水率會破壞物料平衡，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~For moisture content on a dry-mass basis, divide wet mass by one plus moisture ratio. In this model, wet is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 110 kg. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Moisture is water mass divided by dry-solid mass; sampled moisture is representative. Use wet mass and mass after drying as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Mixing wet-basis and dry-basis moisture corrupts mass balance; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：wet=110 kg, w=0.1 1；y=wet/(1+w)=100 kg。只把 wet 增加百分之十，y=110 kg。模型邊界：含水率定義為水質量除乾料質量；水分分布具有代表性；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: wet=110 kg, w=0.1 1; y=wet/(1+w)=100 kg. Increasing only wet with a ten-percent increase gives y=110 kg. Boundary: Moisture is water mass divided by dry-solid mass; sampled moisture is representative; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以濕重及乾燥後質量區分模型與觀察，先用同批濕重、乾燥後恆重及天平校準紀錄建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「含水率乾重換算」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use wet mass and mass after drying to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using wet mass and constant dry mass from one batch plus balance calibration, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Moisture dry-mass conversion. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.
units.failure: 混用濕基與乾基含水率會破壞物料平衡。這個失效與「含水率乾重換算」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查濕重及乾燥後質量，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。~Mixing wet-basis and dry-basis moisture corrupts mass balance. This failure and a measurement bias in Moisture dry-mass conversion can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check wet mass and mass after drying rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. units.verify: 本單元以水頭與流量穩定區段區分模型與觀察，先用穩定水頭時間序列、試體斷面與定時排水量建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「滲透流量比較」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use stable intervals of head and flow to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using stable head history, specimen area and timed discharge volume, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Permeability flow comparison. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.
units.failure: 空氣滯留會使初期流量不能代表穩態。這個失效與「滲透流量比較」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查水頭與流量穩定區段，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。~Trapped air makes initial flow unrepresentative of steady flow. This failure and a measurement bias in Permeability flow comparison can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check stable intervals of head and flow rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

Explain which evidence in stable intervals of head and flow distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.

units.title: 未回收物料比例~Unrecovered material fraction
units.mechanism: 未回收量可以包含秤重誤差、濺散與滯留，不能直接判定偷漏。本模型把 lost 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 3.3 percent。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。分母與差額採同一批次乾質量；比例本身不判定差額原因。使用秤重校正與存量盤點作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；把所有差額當成廢料會掩蓋量測問題，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Unrecovered quantity can include weighing error, spillage and retained inventory; it does not identify a cause by itself. In this model, lost is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 3.3 percent. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Denominator and residual share one batch and dry-mass basis; the ratio does not identify the cause. Use scale calibration and inventory reconciliation as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Labelling every discrepancy as waste hides measurement faults; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：lost=3 t, feed=100 t；y=lost/feed*100=3 percent。只把 lost 增加百分之十，y=3.3 percent。模型邊界：分母與差額採同一批次乾質量；比例本身不判定差額原因；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: lost=3 t, feed=100 t; y=lost/feed*100=3 percent. Increasing only lost with a ten-percent increase gives y=3.3 percent. Boundary: Denominator and residual share one batch and dry-mass basis; the ratio does not identify the cause; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以秤重校正與存量盤點區分模型與觀察，先用各秤重點校準、容器殘料與物料盤點建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「未回收物料比例」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use scale calibration and inventory reconciliation to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using calibration at each scale, retained container material and inventory count, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Unrecovered material fraction. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.
units.failure: 把所有差額當成廢料會掩蓋量測問題。這個失效與「未回收物料比例」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查秤重校正與存量盤點，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。~Labelling every discrepancy as waste hides measurement faults. This failure and a measurement bias in Unrecovered material fraction can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check scale calibration and inventory reconciliation rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

units.practice: 重算「未回收物料比例」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出分母與差額採同一批次乾質量；比例本身不判定差額原因如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由把所有差額當成廢料會掩蓋量測問題造成偏離的合成觀察，以秤重校正與存量盤點說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。~Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Unrecovered material fraction, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Denominator and residual share one batch and dry-mass basis; the ratio does not identify the cause. Explain which evidence in scale calibration and inventory reconciliation distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
